international.title: Aboriginal mother allegedly kicked off a bus in regional NSW because her baby was crying
international.summary: The NSW transport department says passenger safety is its ‘highest priority’ and the driver is no longer employed by the operator Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Transport for NSW is investigating allegations that a young Aboriginal mother and her family were told to leave a bus and left by the side of a regional highway because her 22-month-old child was crying. Wiradjuri woman Kaneesha Lee Williams was travelling home from Sydney to the Riverina town of Darlington Point, 155km west of Wagga Wagga, with her young daughter, Audria, and her mother, Tamara, on Sunday.
